name: @clara/web
description: Clara web app (P1 foundation scaffold). Next.js App Router, deployed to Cloudflare Workers via @opennextjs/cloudflare; replaces apps/dashboard at cutover. See README.md for the rulings pointer and token provenance.

scripts.test: node --import ./test/bootstrap.mjs --import tsx --test lib/parts/catalog.test.tsx lib/parts/hooks.test.ts lib/wire.test.ts lib/read.test.ts lib/doors.test.ts lib/session-accessor.test.ts tests/safe-redirect.test.ts tests/proxy-matcher.test.ts tests/invite-verification.test.ts tests/client-scope.test.ts tests/public-key.test.ts tests/same-origin.test.ts tests/response-state.test.ts lib/documents/reads.test.ts lib/documents/doors.test.ts lib/documents/intake.test.ts lib/documents/useUploadQueue.test.ts lib/documents/copy.test.ts lib/documents/loaders.test.ts lib/documents/bytes.test.ts lib/documents/runtime-wire.test.ts lib/documents/open-in-new-tab.test.ts tests/
scripts.cf:preview: node scripts/check-public-key.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/check-public-key.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
